li_hook: Curves that shoot off to infinity, and curves that settle down far out.
li_step_intro_caption: f(x) = 1/x. What happens as x creeps up on 0?
li_step_predict_caption: Let x close in on 0 from both sides.
li_step_predict_predict_caption: Which way does 1/x shoot off on each side of 0? Pick up or down for each side.
li_step_predict_answer_caption: Left of 0 it plunges to −∞, right of 0 it soars to +∞. They disagree: no limit.
li_step_both_up_caption: 1/(x − 2)² heads to +∞ from both sides. Zoom in: it never comes back.
li_step_at_infinity_caption: Now x itself runs off to ±∞. Drag outward: f(x) settles at 2, a horizontal asymptote.
li_step_continuity_caption: A graph is continuous where you can draw it without lifting the pen. Here it breaks three times.
